# The Widow’s Mite (Mark 12:43)

## Emotional Focus
Giving with a kind and generous heart.

## Key KJV
“This poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury.” (Mark 12:43)

## Gentle Retelling
A poor widow gave her last two tiny coins to God. Jesus said her gift was the biggest because it came from her whole heart.

## Coloring Prompt
The widow quietly dropping two small coins into the offering box; peaceful face.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Even a small kind gift from the heart pleases Jesus.”
